name: Baked sweet potato
intro: Bake it until the skin puffs and the sugars run, split it, and fill it. The potato is the whole dinner.
season_anchor: Sweet potatoes, one or two per person
Black beans, or leftover sausage or lamb

variations.context: The default. Warm the beans with a spoonful of ajvar.
Torn dates melt into the hot potato; feta and chile keep it from being dessert.

variations.ingredients: Lamb or sausage · cool and sharp
variations.context: Whatever's left from the week, with yogurt and pomegranate.

finish: Bake at 400°F for about an hour, on a sheet pan, until the skin puffs away from the flesh and syrup beads out and caramelizes. Split it lengthwise, push the ends in so it opens, salt the inside, and fill it. Bake extra — they reheat well and they're tomorrow's hash.
